scripts.setup: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install && npm --prefix Backend run setup:env
scripts.db:init: npm --prefix Backend run migrate && npm --prefix Backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm --prefix Backend test && npm --prefix Frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix Backend run lint && npm --prefix Frontend run lint
